text:
anya_support: FYI customer (AcmePayments) hit a nasty parsing + billing problem with JSON mode. They call /v1/generate with structured_output=json_array and get partial items with null ids and extra keys, then our client retries and bills double. Need help repro + triage.

anya_support: Observed behavior: a) some items in the response array have "id": null b) other items have an unexpected "meta" field c) downstream parser fails with 'missing required id' and aborts, client retries request -> billing spike.

anya_support: Example response we saved (redacted):
```
[
  {"id": "item_1", "price": 120, "meta": {"trace": "x"}},
  {"id": null, "price": 0, "note": "partial"},
  {"price": 45, "id": "item_3"}  
]
```

liam_eng: thanks. do we know if this came from streaming / chunked output or a single full response?

anya_support: customer says they enable streaming (stream=true) and use json_array mode. They see the null id only when response is streamed. If they retry with stream=false it's stable (no nulls) but slower.

sam_platform: if streaming splits mid-object, our JSON-mode reconstruction should buffer until complete. possible bug where chunk boundary emits a partial object flagged as complete?

liam_eng: can you post the exact curl they used and the request headers (esp Authorization, x-request-id if available)? also which model and quantization?

anya_support: provided curl:
```bash
curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-REDACT" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"rw-infer-3b","stream":true,"structured_output":{"mode":"json_array","schema":{"items":{"type":"object","required":["id","price"]}}},"input":"...batch 500 items..."}'
```

liam_eng: good. prioritize: reproduce with stream=true and a batch payload. I suspect two interacting issues: streaming flush policy + an intermittent post-transform that injects "meta" keys for observability, and when insertion happens after a chunk boundary we might emit an incomplete object.

katie_cs: customer reports billing ~1.8x normal for the day due to automated retries. They want a timeline and a temporary credits offer. Marking this high-impact for CS.

dbot: Ticket created: SUP-2026-3145 (linked to thread). Severity: high. Notifying eng-runtime oncall.

liam_eng: @sam_platform can you pull the request logs for x-request-id in the ticket (they included ids: xreq-9a1b2c)? want raw stream payloads if available. Also collect token counters so we can correlate billing jump.

sam_platform: grabbing logs now. One log snippet shows chunked frames where a closing brace is delayed:
```
chunk 1: [{"id":"item_1","price":120}
chunk 2: ,{"id":null,"price":0,"note":"part
chunk 3: ial"}, {"id":"item_3","price":45}]
```

sam_platform: that reproduces the "id":null token — parser sees "id": null because transform logic patches the id after we already emitted the chunk.

liam_eng: aha. two fixes: 1) ensure we don't emit objects until complete JSON for each item is assembled when structured_output=json_array + stream=true; 2) remove any late-stage mutation that sets id after emit. Both look like codepaths in batch streamer + post-processing.

liam_eng: repro steps for eng: use model rw-infer-3b, stream=true, structured_output.mode=json_array, schema requiring id. Send a small synthetic prompt that triggers post-transform adding id (we have a script). Confirm that with current runtime you can get a null id in the middle object when network flush happens.

anya_support: Customer's repro script attached in ticket; they can reproduce consistently when network latency is ~80-120ms and payload size ~2.5KB per item.

katie_cs: can we offer temporary billing credits while this is being fixed? recommend 15% credit to cover duplicate retries for affected window.

liam_eng: agreed to escalate to eng-runtime. @sam_platform please open a bug with logs and add the minimal failing test. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for post-transform review.

sam_platform: created bug RNDR-8271, uploaded logs + minimal test. Added a failing unit test for stream-assembly.

liam_eng: workaround in the short term: set stream=false for affected customers or add server-side atomic flush (we can toggle a config to buffer until item-complete). Will create a rollout flag.

anya_support: forwarded workaround and provided customer steps. they're ok to toggle stream=false for now.

katie_cs: customer accepts temporary credits and wants ETA. can we get a rough ETA after triage?

liam_eng: after triage: fix + Node+Python SDK patch to avoid exposing partials, plus config flip, estimate 48-72h to hotfix and rollout canary. I'll update SUP-2026-3145.

anya_support: thanks all. keeping customer updated.

sam_platform: note for followup: add additional telemetry that counts incomplete-item emits and raise alert if >0. That'll catch regressions.

liam_eng: agreed. adding to RNDR-8271.

katie_cs: closing loop: applying 15% credit and emailing AcmePayments now.

anya_support: end of thread.
